title: Better SImple Spy
features:
Modded Simpe Spy v3

- added world tracker: logs every spawned and removed instance (parts, models, gui, sounds, tools) with re-create script
- added property watcher: track any instance (Watch Sel / Workspace / Character) with per-change re-apply script
- added attribute watcher: SetAttribute changes with one-click restore
- added require() call logger plus ModuleScript add/remove tracking with auto-watch
- added user input tracking: keys, mouse buttons, touch, down/up with hold duration
- added decal/texture change logging toggle (off by default)
- added tab bar with live search (All / Remotes / World / Props / Modules)
- added pause button and per-category filter toggles
- added class filter (comma-separated) plus remote blacklist/blocklist by instance and by name
- added Export Logs: detailed per-entry JSON saved to workspace (clipboard fallback)
- added full English UI with RU toggle in settings (choice saved to config)
- added 30 switchable themes (Default, Cobalt, Ubuntu, Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox, TokyoNight, Monokai, Solarized, Matrix, Crimson, Ocean, Grape, Sunset, Forest, Arctic, Midnight, Candy, Volcano, Stealth, Rose, Mint, Coffee, Lavender, Ember, Slate, Blood, Ice, Gold, Bubblegum)
- added settings 
- added Copy Remote upgrade: copies paths of both remotes and instances
- added Get Script, Function Info, Decompile support for ModuleScripts and calling scripts
- added weak-executor support (Xeno, Solara): capability detection, LITE mode without hooks, debug/table/getfenv/metatable guards
- added faster Quad-eased minimize animation and fixed tab/search visibility when collapsed
